description: CDW Europe: analysis code and data for a European assessment of construction and demolition waste recovery is published by Anonymous. The code and derived tables compare construction and demolition waste recovery pathways. Its stated coverage is European countries; the study's panel and policy evidence. Further dates and resolution are unknown unless specified by the provider. The provider exposes machine-readable metadata; data files were not downloaded. The inspected public resource is free to access. The licence is mit-license. Reported recovery can combine recycling and backfilling, which the study distinguishes. For simulation, it can inform waste-service capacity planning or comparisons of collection and treatment scenarios; this is a reviewer assessment of potential use. Related record model-swolfpy provides a comparison in the same service area; technical compatibility was not tested.
